title: 第85章 谁家的幸存点是大风刮来的？

第85章 谁家的幸存点是大风刮来的？-《全民饥荒：SSS级天赋酿酒师》

谷正住在驿馆，莫大叔就住在庄园，因而都没有回去的必要。可是流程又必须要走，至于怎么走，都不好拿主意，老人把高峰叫来商议的就是这件事。

红衣翻飞，因为有了白色的威胁，反而沉静了下来。把自己周身护的严密，仔细寻找对方的破绽试探。

节堂中众人互相看看，再度摇头——还是那句话：此人自归来后就足不出户，人家想结交都没什么机会，更不用说结怨。

在家里不敢表露分毫着急的神色，只能化身贴心棉袄，向所有的家人送去温暖，让她们知道不管自己在哪里，也不论在做什么。

南宫世家也就只能在三大侍妾外围加强防守，特别是一到了晚上，整个南宫世家的防守力量加重了至少好几倍。

眼看又是一场大战，林鸿皱了皱眉，他们魔族的大军还没赶到，仅仅凭借天煞门门人的力量，恐怕根本不是这些妖族族人的对手。

此种情况，杨邦乂就是滴酒不沾也得喝下去，何况他确实乏累，喝口酒定能缓解一下，于是接过碗来一口干了。

父母和孩子不能经常不见，那她和丈夫也该好好聚聚吧，毕竟孩子们都大了。

张丽丽感觉脸都没地方放了，头一次，头一次男人这样对她，自己以前只要这样看着一个男人，那个男人就会心疼，什么都听她的，可李志却不，她感觉没法再待下去了，她转身要离开。

黄昶发现自己疏忽了一件事——这个幻影分身毕竟只是心魔殿中那面魔镜制造出来的一个复制品而已，用来考核试炼弟子的，而这些试炼弟子的平均水准只在炼气中期，所以这个复制品的战斗力，最多也只能限制在这种程度。

Gu Zheng lives in the post house and Uncle Mo lives in the manor, so there is no need to go back.But the process had to be followed, and it was hard to make a decision as to how to proceed. This was what the old man called Gao Feng to discuss.

The man in red clothes fluttered, but because of the threat of white, he calmed down.Protect yourself tightly and carefully look for the other party's flaws to test.

Everyone in the festival hall looked at each other and shook their heads again - it was the same sentence: This person has not left home since his return, and there is no chance for others to make friends, let alone make enemies.

I don't dare to show any signs of anxiety at home, so I can only turn into a caring cotton-padded jacket and send warmth to all my family members, letting them know that no matter where they are or what they are doing.

The Nangong family could only strengthen its defense around the three concubines. Especially at night, the entire Nangong family's defensive strength increased at least several times.

Seeing another big battle, Lin Hong frowned. The demon army hadn't arrived yet. With just the strength of the Tiansha clan, they probably wouldn't be a match for these demon clan members.

In this case, Yang Bangyi had to drink even if he didn't drink. Besides, he was really tired. A drink of wine would definitely relieve him, so he took the bowl and drank it in one gulp.

Parents and children cannot be separated from each other often, so she and her husband should have a good get-together, after all, the children are grown up.

Zhang Lili felt like she had no place to put her face. This was the first time, the first time a man had treated her like this. In the past, whenever she looked at a man like this, that man would feel distressed and would obey her in everything, but not Li Zhi. She felt that she could not stay any longer, so she turned to leave.

Huang Chang found that he had overlooked one thing - after all, this phantom clone was just a copy of the magic mirror in the Heart Demon Palace, used to assess the trial disciples, and the average level of these trial disciples was only in the middle stage of Qi Refining, so the combat effectiveness of this replica could only be limited to this level at best.
